enforcement.accessor: H6FieldAccess — SANITIZING. Forbidden values are never stored: construction validates inbound keys and retains only admitted data in an immutable mapping.
enforcement.boundary: feature_authority.admitted_observation — FAIL-CLOSED. A row carrying a forbidden or unadmitted field is rejected BEFORE any aggregation/feature/signal exists.
enforcement.runtime_path: preparation.prepare_decision / prepare_decision_from_data_root is the actual H6 runtime entry point and calls the fail-closed boundary first.
